summary_en: ¥4.00 per share commemorative dividend, ¥12.0M total, payable 2026-08-31, sourced from retained earnings. Announced following dual listing on Tokyo PRO Market (July 2025) and Fukuoka PRO Market (December 2025).
title_en: Notice of Dividend on Surplus (Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Higuchi Consulting announced a commemorative dividend of ¥4.00 per share, totalling ¥12.0M, decided at the board meeting on 31 July 2026 with record date 31 May 2026 and effective date 31 August 2026. The dividend is sourced from retained earnings and will be submitted for approval at the 16th annual shareholder meeting scheduled for 28 August 2026. The company stated the dividend commemorates its dual listing milestones: listing on Tokyo PRO Market on 4 July 2025 and on Fukuoka PRO Market on 26 December 2025. The company characterised this as the first dividend-paying fiscal period following its dual-listing achievement.
